credits.title: Allen
credits.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

credits.title: The Neon Highway
credits.overview: A car crash ended Wayne Collins' dream to make it in Nashville, but a chance encounter with a country music legend rekindles the flame.

credits.title: Resort to Love
credits.overview: Aspiring pop star Erica ends up as the entertainment at her ex-fiancé’s wedding after reluctantly taking a gig at a luxurious island resort while in the wake of a music career meltdown.

credits.title: The Bus to Birra Birra
credits.overview: Arielle's path changes forever when she befriends a young man whose fate rests on the outcome of his journey home from prison.

credits.title: Loves Me, Loves Me Not
credits.overview: Ali Silver searches for Mr. Right but finds misadventures that are darkly outrageous and sexy with an assortment of ne'er-do-wells who are inappropriate, unobtainable or unmanageable. Looking for Mr. Goodbar meets Sex and the City.

credits.title: Your Call Is Important to Us
credits.overview: Employee of the Month Doug takes immense pride in his work and today, just like any other day, he intends for his contribution at a call centre to make an impact.

credits.title: OtherLife
credits.overview: Ren Amari is the driven inventor of a revolutionary new drug. OtherLife expands the brain's sense of time and creates virtual reality directly in the user's mind. With OtherLife, mere seconds in real life feel like hours or days of exciting adventures. As Ren and her colleagues race around the clock to launch OtherLife

credits.title: Halfway
credits.overview: A recently released convict finds himself trapped between his urban criminal past and his new life on probation as the only black man in a conservative white Wisconsin farming town.

credits.title: Molly
credits.overview: The story of how, from the early 1970s, Australia's eccentric Ian 'Molly' Meldrum became a loved and respected rock music guru as host of the TV show Countdown.

credits.title: The Little Death
credits.overview: A comedy film that looks into the loosely connected lives of people with strange sexual fantasies.

credits.title: Eat Pray Love
credits.overview: A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she takes off on a round-the-world journey to "find herself".
